target_customer: Engineering teams and developers paying for AI coding agents with their own model keys or subscriptions
problem: Autonomous coding agents are costly per task and tied to one sandbox. Reason claims 30 to 50 percent lower cost per task and agents that work across cloud and local devices.
business_model: Software with bring your own keys or subscriptions; pricing not disclosed
product_category: Autonomous cloud coding agent and harness

founders.name: Adi Singh
founders.role: Co-founder (CEO per Dealroom and other sources)
prior_employers: Scale AI (applied ML, per launch post)
founders.background_notes: Built a Rust-based IDE from scratch per YC page.

founders.name: Sven Myhre
founders.background_notes: Won the 2025 Norwegian AI Championship and a Supabase AI hackathon award at YC; president of Cogito.

competitors.what: Cloud agents in isolated VMs, headline of Cursor 3.5

competitors.what: Cloud sandboxed coding agent running parallel background tasks

competitors.what: Autonomous software engineer launched in late 2024
competitors.traction_then: Listed among top cloud agents in 2026 roundups

competitors.name: GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Google Jules, Factory Droid

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent harness that runs across cloud and local devices with cost control and about 100 integrations, built by two people, at the edge of frontier model capability.

defensibility.rationale: Harness advantage depends on cost claims that frontier labs can match; bring your own key model lowers lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large players already shipped cloud agents before founding; no action on Reason Machines found.

market_need_then: Heavy and rising AI coding spend and rate limits on subscriptions in 2026; the company's wedge is cost per task and rolling over to the next key when limits hit.

branding.domain_note: Uses reasonmachines.com for the company; product called Reason. Earlier product name Ara appears in one directory, unverified.

identity.logo: Black, transparent logo file; design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and promotional, headline calls Reason the world's most effective agent

branding.community_and_virality: Launch posted on X on 2026-10-19 and covered by runtimewire; no community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared with many products, no brand press found beyond launch coverage.

outcome_analysis: Reason Machines is a two person Fall 2026 company with no exit and no confirmed funding. Its October 2026 launch claims lower cost per task than Codex, but those are the company's own claims. The main risk is that frontier labs and Cursor already ship cloud agents and can undercut on cost.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125k USD seed with no investors; one aggregator only, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Sources conflict on batch (Spring 2026 per some directories vs Fall 2026 per the directory data). Role titles for Adi Singh come from aggregators, the YC page lists both as co-founders. Completeness pass: the $125k seed (no date or investors) is recorded from Dealroom alone, a single database, and may be the YC standard deal.
